contentBody.headMarkup:
<title>Pronto Customer Site</title>

<!-- branding stylesheets -->

<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/salesforce-lightning-design-system.min.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-site-spacing-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-slds-extensions.min.css?{ versionKey }" />



<!-- branding stylesheets-->

<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ styles/styles.css }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ styles/print.css }" media="print"/>

<style>
.customer-header {
    background-color: #ffffff;
    font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #eaeaea;
}

.customer-header__logo {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.customer-header__logo img {
    max-height: 80px; /* Match logo size with customer header */
    padding-top: 5px;
    padding-bottom: 5px;
}

.customer-header__right {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 20px; /* Space between links and button */
}

.customer-header__nav {
    display: flex;
    gap: 25px; /* Space between navigation links */
}

.customer-header__nav-item {
        text-decoration: none;
    color: #1e4c82;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
    line-height: 1; /* Ensure proper vertical alignment */
}
    
.customer-header__nav-item:hover {
    color: #0070d2; /* Blue on hover */
}

.customer-header__button {
    font-size: 0.9rem !important;
    font-weight: bold !important;
    background-color: #AD343E !important; /* Button color */
    color: #ffffff !important; /* White text */
    padding: 8px 16px !important;
    border-radius: 4px !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    border: none !important;
    transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease !important;
    display: inline-block !important;
    text-align: center !important;
}

.customer-header__button:hover {
    background-color: #982E35 !important; /* Slightly darker hover color */
    transform: scale(1.05) !important; /* Subtle hover effect */
}

/* Responsive Adjustments: Hide menu and button on mobile */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .customer-header__right {
        display: none; /* Hide menu items and button on smaller screens */
    }
}
    
/* General Footer Styles */
.slds-footer {
    background-color: #f3f3f3;
    padding: 40px 20px;
    font-family: 'Salesforce Sans', Arial, sans-serif;
}

.slds-footer-title {
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    color: #16325c;
}

.slds-footer-section {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.slds-footer-links {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
}

.slds-footer-links li {
    margin: 5px 0;
}

.slds-footer-links a,.slds-footer-links a:visited {
    color: #0070d2;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 14px;
}

.slds-footer-links a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}

.slds-footer-copy {
    text-align: center;
    margin-top: 20px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #50575e;
}

.slds-social-icons img {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    filter: saturate(500%) contrast(800%) brightness(500%)
        invert(80%) sepia(50%) hue-rotate(120deg);
}

.slds-app-downloads img {
    height: 40px;
    margin-right: 15px;
}

/* Hero Section */
.hero {
    background: url("/sfsites/c/resource/prontosite/pronto-site/pronto-customer-hero.png")
        no-repeat center center;
    background-size: cover;
    color: #16325c;
    padding: 60px 20px;
    font-family: 'Salesforce Sans', Arial, sans-serif;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    height: 400px;
    text-align: right;
    flex-wrap: wrap; /* Adjust content wrapping */
}

.hero__content {
    max-width: 600px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
}

.hero__headline {
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.hero__subheadline {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
    color: #5a6872;
}

.hero__cta button {
    background-color: #ff6f61;
    color: #ffffff;
    border: none;
    padding: 12px 20px;
    font-size: 1rem;
    border-radius: 5px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: bold;
    transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
}

.hero__cta button:hover {
    background-color: #e6554f;
    transform: scale(1.05);
}

/* Customer Card Section */
.customer-card-section {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 40px 20px;
    background-color: #f9f9f9;
    font-family: 'Salesforce Sans', Arial, sans-serif;
}

.customer-card-section__title {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    color: #333333;
}

.customer-card-section__subtitle {
    font-size: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
    color: #5a6872;
}

.customer-cards {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap; /* Adjust for responsiveness */
}

.customer-card {
    flex: 1 1 calc(20% - 20px); /* Five cards in a row */
    max-width: 180px;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #eaeaea;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 20px;
    text-align: center;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

.customer-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
}

.customer-card__icon {
    margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.customer-card__icon img {
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
    filter: invert(15%) sepia(87%) saturate(500%) hue-rotate(275deg) brightness(90%)
        contrast(95%);
}

.customer-card__title {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    color: #16325c;
    min-height: 50px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
}

/* Support Section */
.support-section {
    padding: 20px 10px;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
    text-align: center;
}

.support-section__title {
    font-size: 1.6rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #333333;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.support-section__subtitle {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #666666;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.support-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 15px;
    justify-content: center;
}

.support-card {
    background-color: #f9f9f9;
    border: 1px solid #dddddd;
    border-radius: 8px;
    max-width: 600px;
    padding: 15px;
    text-align: center;
    flex: 1;
}

.support-card__icon {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.support-card__header {
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #333333;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.support-card__body {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #555555;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.support-card__footer a {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #0070d2;
    text-decoration: none;
}

.support-card__footer a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}

/* Responsive Adjustments */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .hero {
        height: auto;
        padding: 40px 20px;
        text-align: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .hero__content {
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 20px;
    }

    .customer-cards,
    .support-grid {
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    .customer-card,
    .support-card {
        max-width: 100%;
    }
}
</style>
